words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.ex: He worked hard, and ultimately succeeded.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，最终成功了。
words.en: You use ultimately to indicate that something is the final result of a series of events or the most important part of a situation.

words.tr: adj. 难以忍受的；不能容忍的
words.ex: The heat was unbearable.
words.ex_cn: 天气热得难以忍受。
words.en: If you describe something as unbearable, you mean that it is so unpleasant, painful, or upsetting that you feel unable to accept it or deal with it.

chapters.name: Unit 4 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: My friend always backs up my ideas in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 我的朋友总是在会议上支持我的想法。
words.en: To support someone or something; to make a copy of computer data to protect against loss.

words.ex: This problem is related to math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 厌烦的；受够了的；极度不满的
words.ex: I am fed up with doing the same work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我厌倦了每天做同样的工作。
words.en: If you are fed up, you are unhappy, bored, or tired of something, especially something that you have been experiencing for a long time.

words.ex: This problem has to do with counting money.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数钱有关。
words.en: to be connected or associated with something

words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.tr: phrase. 抄近路；走捷径；采取简便方法
words.ex: He took a shortcut to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他抄近路以节省时间。
words.en: To take a more direct or quicker route than the usual one, often to save time or effort.

words.tr: phrase. （因焦虑、沮丧或愤怒）抓狂，极度烦恼
words.ex: He tears his hair out when he sees the messy room.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到凌乱的房间时，他急得抓头发。
words.en: If you say that someone is tearing their hair out, you mean that they are extremely worried or upset about something.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Part Two New Words

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.tr: n. 床上用品；寝具； v. “bed”的现在分词；
words.ex: She bought new bedding for her bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室买了新的床上用品。
words.en: Bedding refers to the materials that are used on a bed for sleeping on, such as sheets and blankets.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: The doorbell rang when the mail arrived.
words.ex_cn: 邮件到达时，门铃响了。
words.en: A doorbell is a button or switch outside a door that you press or turn to make a sound inside the building, signaling someone to open the door.

words.tr: n. 梦想家；空想家；不切实际的人；
words.ex: He is a dreamer who wants to change the world.
words.ex_cn: 他是个想要改变世界的人。
words.en: A dreamer is someone who has a lot of ideas and plans for the future but is not practical or realistic about them.

words.tr: n. 热心者；热衷于…的人
words.ex: He is an enthusiast of basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球的爱好者。
words.en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；让人懊恼的； v. “frustrate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The slow internet is frustrating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人沮丧。
words.en: If something is frustrating, it annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.ex: The inner room is quiet and dark.
words.ex_cn: 内部的房间安静而昏暗。
words.en: Located inside or further in; relating to the mind or spirit.

words.ex: He answered the question instantly.
words.ex_cn: 他立即回答了问题。
words.en: If something happens instantly, it happens immediately.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.tr: vi. （指枪、发动机等）不发火，不启动; （指计划等）失败 n. 不发火，失败
words.ex: The gun misfired and did not shoot.
words.ex_cn: 枪走火了，没有射出子弹。
words.en: If a plan or joke misfires, it fails to have the intended effect.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.ex: He talked nonsense and no one understood him.
words.ex_cn: 他说了一些无意义的话，没人能理解他。
words.en: If you say that something spoken or written is nonsense, you mean that you consider it to be untrue or silly.

words.ex: The black cat is an omen of bad luck.
words.ex_cn: 黑猫是不祥之兆。
words.en: An omen is an event or phenomenon that is believed to foretell the future, often signifying the advent of change.

words.ex: His physiological response to stress is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 他对压力的生理反应非常强烈。
words.en: Physiological refers to the normal functions of living organisms and their parts, or to the branch of biology that deals with these functions.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.tr: n. 精神分析学家；心理分析学者（或医生）
words.ex: The psychoanalyst helped her understand the root causes of her anxiety.
words.ex_cn: 这位精神分析学家帮助她理解了焦虑的根源。
words.en: A psychoanalyst is a person who treats mental illness by investigating the unconscious mind and the conscious mind's relation to it.

words.ex: The logo is recognizable even from far away.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志即使从远处也能辨认出来。
words.en: Able to be recognized or identified from previous encounters or knowledge.

words.tr: n. 录音；录制； v. 记录；录制；“record”的现在分词；
words.ex: I listened to the recording of the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我听了讲座的录音。
words.en: A recording is a piece of music or speech that has been recorded, or the process of making such a record.

words.ex: The problem recurs every week.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题每周都会再次出现。
words.en: If something recurs, it happens again, either once or several times.

words.tr:
adj. 下意识的；潜意识的；
n. 潜意识；下意识；
words.ex: He made a subconscious decision to help her.
words.ex_cn: 他下意识地决定帮助她。
words.en: The subconscious is the part of your mind that contains feelings and thoughts that you are not directly aware of but that can influence your behavior and emotions.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

chapters.name: Unit 5 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrasal verb. 忙于……；被……缠住；与……有密切关联
words.ex: He is tied up with work today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天忙于工作。
words.en: To be closely involved with something or busy with something.

words.ex: This castle dates back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: If something dates back to a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

chapters.name: Unit 5 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.tr: n. 教堂墓地；教堂周围的空地
words.ex: The churchyard was filled with ancient tombstones.
words.ex_cn: 教堂院落里满是古老的墓碑。
words.en: A churchyard is an area of land around a church where dead people are buried.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.ex: The elm tree stands near the old house.
words.ex_cn: 榆树长在老房子旁边。
words.en: An elm is a type of tree that is common in northern countries, which has broad leaves and can grow to a great size.

words.ex: Children walk on the footpath to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在人行道上步行去学校。
words.en: A footpath is a path that is designed for people to walk along, especially one in the countryside or a park.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: n. 小路；小巷；航道；车道；航线；
words.ex: The children walked down the narrow lane to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们沿着狭窄的小路去上学。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. It can also refer to a division of a road intended to separate lines of traffic moving in the same or opposite directions.

words.tr: n. 自然学家；博物学家；
words.ex: The naturalist studied birds in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位自然学家在森林里研究鸟类。
words.en: A naturalist is a person who studies or is an expert in natural history, especially a zoologist or botanist.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.ex: She had a premonition that something bad was going to happen.
words.ex_cn: 她有一种不祥的预感，觉得会有坏事发生。
words.en: A premonition is a feeling that something, especially something unpleasant, is going to happen.

words.ex: The child ripped the paper with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用手把纸撕裂了。
words.en: To rip something means to tear it quickly and forcefully.

words.tr: v. 使粉碎；使破碎；使破灭；
words.ex: The stone shattered when it hit the ground.
words.ex_cn: 石头撞到地面时碎裂了。
words.en: If something shatters or is shattered, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 重击；捶击；发撞击声
n. 重击声；重打
words.ex: He thumped the table with his fist.
words.ex_cn: 他用拳头重击了桌子。
words.en: If you thump something, you hit it hard, usually with your fist.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.ex: She bought a wicker basket for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 她为野餐买了一个柳条篮子。
words.en: Wicker is the material made from weaving thin branches or twigs, especially from willows, used to make baskets, furniture, etc.

chapters.name: Unit 5 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.tr: 短语动词. 停止；停下；停止前进
words.ex: The car came to a halt at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: To stop moving or doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 在...之上；加之；紧接着
words.ex: The book is on top of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In addition to; in control of or fully informed about something.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的顶部；在…之上；完全掌控；除…之外
words.ex: She placed the book on the top of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在书架的顶部。
words.en: On the top of means at the highest part or point of something, or in addition to.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

chapters.name: Unit 5 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: He actively participates in class discussions.
words.ex_cn: 他积极参加课堂讨论。
words.en: In a way that involves positive action or participation.

words.tr: v. 唤醒；唤起；使意识到
words.ex: The loud noise awakened him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把他吵醒了。
words.en: If you awaken a feeling or emotion, or if it awakens, it starts to be felt or experienced.

words.tr: adj. 抑郁的； v. 降低；“depress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt depressed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到抑郁。
words.en: If you are depressed, you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: The city is progressively becoming more crowded.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在逐步变得更加拥挤。
words.en: In a way that happens or develops gradually or in stages; increasingly.

words.ex: Drugs can relieve pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To relieve someone or something means to make a problem, pain, or unpleasant feeling less severe or to take it away completely.

words.ex: The separation of the two chemicals caused a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质的分离引起了反应。
words.en: The act of separating or the state of being separated.

words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

chapters.name: Unit 5 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrasal verb. 凭空想出；虚构；杜撰（想法、计划或故事等）
words.ex: He can dream up funny stories in a minute.
words.ex_cn: 他一分钟就能编出有趣的故事。
words.en: To invent or imagine something, especially something that is not practical or likely to happen.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents now and then.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: Occasionally; from time to time.

words.ex: He left right away when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他一听到消息就离开了。
words.en: If you do something right away, you do it immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 完成；解决；逐渐穿过；穿透
words.ex: He worked through all the math problems before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了所有的数学题。
words.en: To deal with or solve a problem or task completely or thoroughly.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Part Two New Words

words.ex: The anthropologist studies ancient tribes.
words.ex_cn: 这位人类学家研究古代部落。
words.en: An anthropologist is a person who studies anthropology, which is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: The boxer trained every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位拳击手每天早上训练。
words.en: A boxer is someone who takes part in the sport of boxing, or a breed of dog with a short coat and a square-shaped muzzle.

words.ex: I eat broccoli with dinner every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚餐都吃西兰花。
words.en: Broccoli is a vegetable with a green flower head and a thick stalk, eaten as a vegetable.

words.ex: A butterfly is flying over the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝴蝶在花上飞舞。
words.en: A butterfly is an insect with large, often brightly coloured wings.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: He bought the shirt cheaply at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上便宜地买到了这件衬衫。
words.en: If something is done cheaply, it is done at a low cost.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人作呕的； v. “disgust”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of the rotten food was disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂食物的气味令人厌恶。
words.en: If you say that something is disgusting, you mean that you find it completely unacceptable or unpleasant.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: Bees help to fertilize flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂帮助花朵受精。
words.en: To fertilize means to make soil or land more fertile or productive by adding substances to it, or to cause an egg, female animal, or plant to develop a new individual by introducing male reproductive material.

words.tr: phrase. 食品销售者；卖食物的人
words.ex: The food seller sells noodles every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个食品摊贩每天早上卖面条。
words.en: A person or entity that sells food products.

words.ex: The school forbids students to use phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: To forbid something means to order that it must not be done.

words.ex: She added a gram of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了一克盐。
words.en: A gram is a unit of weight in the metric system equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃一个汉堡包。
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.ex: Farmers spread manure on the fields to help crops grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民把肥料撒在田里以帮助庄稼生长。
words.en: Manure is organic matter used as fertilizer in agriculture.

words.tr: adj. 令人恶心的，使人厌恶的 v. 使恶心，作呕( nauseate的现在分词 )
words.ex: The smell of the garbage is nauseating.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾的气味令人作呕。
words.en: If you describe something as nauseating, you mean it makes you feel nausea or disgust.

words.tr: n. 游牧民；流浪者；游牧生活；流浪生活
words.ex: The nomad walks with his sheep across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 游牧民带着他的羊群穿越沙漠。
words.en: A nomad is someone who has no permanent home and moves according to the seasons from place to place in search of food, water, and grazing land.

words.ex: The nomadic family moves with their sheep every season.
words.ex_cn: 这个游牧家庭每季都随着羊群迁移。
words.en: A nomadic way of life is one in which people move from place to place instead of living in one place all the time.

words.ex: Eating fruits and vegetables is nutritious.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜是有营养的。
words.en: Nutritious food contains substances which help your body to be healthy.

words.ex: He eats pork for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃猪肉当晚餐。
words.en: Pork is meat from a pig, usually fresh and not smoked or salted.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The cat chased the rat under the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫追着老鼠跑到了桌子底下。
words.en: A rat is a small animal with a long tail that looks like a large mouse and is considered a pest.

words.ex: The temple is a sacred place for believers.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙对信徒来说是神圣的地方。
words.en: Something that is sacred is considered to be holy or connected with God or a god.

words.ex: The water is sufficiently warm to swim.
words.ex_cn: 水温足够暖和，可以游泳。
words.en: To an adequate degree; enough.

words.ex: It is a taboo to speak his name in this village.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村子里，提到他的名字是禁忌。
words.en: A taboo is a social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or forbidding association with a particular person, place, or thing.

words.ex: He got trichinosis from eating raw pork.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃了生猪肉而得了旋毛虫病。
words.en: Trichinosis is a disease caused by eating raw or undercooked meat containing the larvae of a species of roundworm Trichinella spiralis.

chapters.name: Unit 6 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 把…视为…；认为…是…；把…看作…
words.ex: Many people regard him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 许多人把他看作英雄。
words.en: To consider or think of someone or something in a specified way.

chapters.name: Unit 6 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the chalkboard.
words.ex_cn: 老师在黑板上写字。
words.en: A chalkboard is a dark-colored board that you can write on with chalk and then clean off.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr: adv. 大幅度地；相当地；很大地；
words.ex: The price has increased considerably.
words.ex_cn: 价格大幅上涨了。
words.en: To a notably large or significant extent.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.tr: n. 就餐者；小餐馆；餐车
words.ex: The diner ate a burger and fries quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位就餐者快速吃了一个汉堡和薯条。
words.en: A diner is a person who is eating a meal, especially in a restaurant. It can also refer to a small, informal restaurant.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: He submitted the documentation for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了项目的文件。
words.en: Documentation refers to the act of providing documents or the documents themselves, which serve as evidence or records of something.

words.tr:
adj. 免下车即可得到服务的
n. 免下车餐馆；免下车电影院；免下车商业场所
words.ex: We ate burgers at a drive-in last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在汽车餐厅吃了汉堡。
words.en: A drive-in is a place such as a restaurant or cinema where you can be served or watch a film without leaving your car.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.ex: The effectiveness of the new medicine was proven in trials.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药的有效性在试验中得到了证实。
words.en: The ability to produce a desired or intended result.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: He designs graphics for video games.
words.ex_cn: 他为电子游戏设计绘图。
words.en: Graphics are visual images or designs on some surface, such as a wall, canvas, screen, paper, or stone, to inform, illustrate, or entertain.

words.ex: Follow the guideline to complete the form.
words.ex_cn: 按照指导路线完成表格。
words.en: A guideline is a set of rules or instructions that are given by an official organization telling you how to do something, especially something difficult.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.tr: adj. 手写的； v. “handwrite”的现在分词；
words.ex: He submitted a handwritten letter to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向老师提交了一封手写的信。
words.en: Written by hand, not printed or typed.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.tr: adj. 不切实际的；不实用的；
words.ex: It's impractical to walk to work every day if you live 50 kilometers away.
words.ex_cn: 如果你住得离工作地点50公里远，每天步行上班是不切实际的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as impractical, you mean that they are not good at planning or organizing things in a practical way, or that their ideas or methods are not suitable for a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 易读性；易辨认；易理解；
words.ex: The legibility of the sign is important for drivers.
words.ex_cn: 标志的易读性对司机来说很重要。
words.en: The quality of being clear enough to read.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: His painting shows great originality.
words.ex_cn: 他的画作展现了极大的独创性。
words.en: The quality of being new and original in a way that is not derived from something else.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.tr: adj. 令人高兴的； v. “please”的现在分词；
words.ex: The pleasing smell of cookies made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 饼干令人高兴的香味让她笑了。
words.en: Something that is pleasing gives you pleasure or satisfaction.

words.ex: The quiet music was a prelude to the loud concert.
words.ex_cn: 轻柔的音乐是盛大音乐会的前奏。
words.en: A prelude is an introductory piece of music, event, or action that comes before a more important one.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr: n. 印刷；印刷术； v. “print”的现在分词；
words.ex: The printing of books started long ago.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的印刷很久以前就开始了。
words.en: Printing is the process of producing texts and images, typically with ink on paper using a printing press.

words.ex: The publication of his book was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 他的书的出版被推迟了。
words.en: The act of making something available to the public, especially a book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr:
n. 限额配给；定量供应
v. 配给；定量供应；“ration”的现在分词
words.ex: The government started rationing food during the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争期间，政府开始对食物进行配给。
words.en: The system of limiting the amount of something that each person is allowed to have, especially when there is not enough of it.

words.tr: n. 朗诵；朗读；背诵；逐个叙述
words.ex: The boy did a recitation of the poem in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上背诵了这首诗。
words.en: A recitation is the act of saying a piece of poetry or literature that you have learned to an audience.

words.tr: adj. 单个的；单数的；特异的；
words.ex: Each singular student must submit a form.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都必须提交一份表格。
words.en: In grammar, singular means relating to or being a form of a word that refers to one person or thing.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

chapters.name: Unit 6 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.

words.tr: phrase. 在外吃饭；上馆子吃饭
words.ex: They eat out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们在周末外出吃饭。
words.en: To have a meal at a restaurant rather than at home.

words.tr: 短语动词. 因……而称赞或认可某人；承认某人在某事上的贡献或努力
words.ex: We should give him credit for trying hard.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该肯定他努力尝试。
words.en: To acknowledge or recognize someone for something they have done, often implying appreciation or praise for their effort or achievement.

chapters.name: Unit 6 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.tr: adv. 有吸引力地；动人地
words.ex: She dressed attractively for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对穿得很有吸引力。
words.en: In a way that is pleasing or appealing to the senses.

words.tr:
adj. 令人困惑的；使人糊涂的
v. 使迷惑；使昏乱；“bewilder”的现在分词
words.ex: The maze was bewildering.
words.ex_cn: 这个迷宫令人困惑。
words.en: If something is bewildering, it is very confusing and difficult to understand or to make a decision about.

words.ex: The soup was too bland for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太淡了，我不喜欢。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as bland, you mean that they are rather dull and unexciting.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.ex: The river marks the borderline between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河标志着两个国家的边界线。
words.en: If you describe something as borderline, you mean that it is only just acceptable as a member of a class or group, or that it is only just good enough to be considered as such.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He chopped the carrots into small pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他把胡萝卜剁成了小块。
words.en: To chop something means to cut it into pieces with a sharp tool such as a knife or axe. It can also refer to the act of reducing something in amount or size.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: The store is open 24 hours for your convenience.
words.ex_cn: 商店24小时营业，以方便您。
words.en: The state of being able to proceed with something with little effort or difficulty.

words.ex: She learned cookery from her grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 她向祖母学习烹调法。
words.en: Cookery is the activity or skill of preparing and cooking food.

words.ex: The apple has a nice crispness when you bite it.
words.ex_cn: 当你咬苹果时，它有一种很好的脆感。
words.en: The quality of being crisp, especially in a way that is pleasing to the senses.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.ex: He eats curry every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上吃咖喱。
words.en: Curry refers to a variety of dishes originating in the Indian subcontinent that use a complex combination of spices or herbs, usually including ground turmeric, cumin, coriander, ginger, and fresh or dried chilies. It also refers to the act of grooming a horse with a special comb.

words.tr: adj. 眼花缭乱的；耀眼的； v. “dazzle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dazzling lights of the city made her blink.
words.ex_cn: 城市的耀眼灯光让她眨了眨眼。
words.en: If you describe something as dazzling, you mean that it is extremely impressive, beautiful, or skilful.

words.ex: He can discriminating between real and fake coins.
words.ex_cn: 他能区分真币和假币。
words.en: If you describe someone as discriminating, you mean that they are able to recognize and appreciate the good qualities of something, especially things that are of high quality.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.ex: He is a fiery man who gets angry easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个容易发怒的暴躁男人。
words.en: If you describe something as fiery, you mean that it is burning strongly or contains fire. It can also describe someone's temper or speech as being very passionate or intense.

words.ex: Goodness, I didn't expect to see you here!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我没料到会在这里见到你！
words.en: Goodness is the quality of being kind, helpful, and honest.

words.ex: He has an inclination to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他有帮助他人的倾向。
words.en: An inclination is a feeling that makes you want to act in a particular way, or a tendency to do something.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: This store sells inexpensive clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖不贵的衣服。
words.en: Something that is inexpensive does not cost a lot of money.

words.tr: adj. 有独创性的；巧妙的；
words.ex: The child came up with an ingenious way to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子想出了一个有独创性的方式来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Something that is ingenious is very clever and involves new ideas, methods, or equipment.

words.ex: The cat made an instinctive jump to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫本能地跳开以躲避狗。
words.en: An instinctive feeling, action, or idea is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

words.ex: He is interested in linguistic patterns in children.
words.ex_cn: 他对儿童的语言模式感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to language or linguistics.

words.ex: The locality has many small shops and cafes.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多小商店和咖啡馆。
words.en: A locality is a particular place or area, especially in relation to its geographical position or features.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.ex: This food has good nutritional value.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物有很好的营养价值。
words.en: Relating to the process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: She seeks perfection in everything she does.
words.ex_cn: 她在所做的每件事中都追求完美。
words.en: The state of being perfect; the highest degree of excellence or quality.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.ex: He faced racial discrimination at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中遭遇了种族歧视。
words.en: Relating to the common characteristics of different races of people, especially in the context of social or cultural differences.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: He performed remarkably well in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中表现得非常出色。
words.en: In a way that is worthy of attention; strikingly.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: The sophistication of the machine allows it to work very precisely.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的精密使其能够非常精确地工作。
words.en: Sophistication refers to the quality of being sophisticated, which includes complexity, refinement, and worldly experience.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: She buys soy to make tofu.
words.ex_cn: 她买大豆来做豆腐。
words.en: Soy refers to the beans of a widely cultivated Asian plant that are used as a source of protein and for making products such as tofu and soy sauce.

words.ex: He adds soy sauce to his rice.
words.ex_cn: 他往米饭里加酱油。
words.en: A dark salty sauce made from fermented soybeans, used in Asian cooking.

words.ex: This restaurant is famous for its specialty, fried dumplings.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅以特色菜煎饺而闻名。
words.en: A specialty is a particular area of study or expertise that someone has, or a product that is particularly associated with a specific place.

words.ex: The cake had a rich, spiced flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这块蛋糕有着浓郁的五香味。
words.en: Having had spices added to enhance flavor.

words.ex: The soup is too spicy for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤对我来说太辣了。
words.en: Food that is spicy has a strong, hot flavor.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；重要的；
n. 主要产品；主要部分；主食；
words.ex: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
words.ex_cn: 大米是许多亚洲国家的主要食物。
words.en: A staple is a basic food that is eaten regularly and in such quantities that it constitutes a dominant portion of a standard diet for a given people, supplying a large fraction of energy needs and generally forming a significant proportion of the intake of other nutrients as well.

words.ex: She smiled subtly when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 她听到这个消息时微妙地笑了。
words.en: In a way that is so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe.

words.ex: The supreme leader makes the final decision.
words.ex_cn: 至上的领导人做出最终决定。
words.en: If you say that something is supreme, you mean that it is the most important or the best of its kind.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.ex: The traveler walked through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅行者穿过森林。
words.en: A traveler is a person who is traveling or who often travels.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.ex: The weather shows a lot of variation in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天天气变化很大。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, level, or form of something.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

chapters.name: Unit 6 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Part Two New Words

words.ex: He made an abrupt stop at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 他在红灯前突然停了下来。
words.en: If something happens abruptly, it happens suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: The music accompanies the dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐伴随舞蹈。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to play a musical accompaniment for.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: He is constantly checking his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不断地查看他的手机。
words.en: If something happens constantly, it happens all the time or very often.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: The delegation met with the president yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 代表团昨天会见了总统。
words.en: A delegation is a group of people who have been sent somewhere to have talks with other people on behalf of a larger group of people.

words.ex: Don't discourage him from trying.
words.ex_cn: 不要阻止他尝试。
words.en: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: He said farewell to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们道别。
words.en: Farewell is an expression of good wishes at parting, often used to say goodbye.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.tr:
v. 使惊慌失措；使慌张
n. 慌张；慌乱
words.ex: He got flustered when the teacher asked him a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问他问题时，他变得慌乱了。
words.en: If you fluster someone, you make them feel nervous and confused by rushing them or by making it difficult for them to concentrate on what they are doing.

words.ex: He walked forth to meet the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去迎接太阳。
words.en: Forward in time, place, or order; onward.

words.tr: int. （对启程的人的祝愿语）成功；如意；幸运
words.ex: Godspeed on your journey!
words.ex_cn: 祝你旅途顺利！
words.en: Used to express good wishes to someone starting a journey or undertaking.

words.tr: adv. 优美地；优雅地；温文地
words.ex: She danced gracefully across the stage.
words.ex_cn: 她优雅地在舞台上跳舞。
words.en: In a smooth, elegant, or attractive manner.

words.ex: Her graciousness made everyone feel at ease.
words.ex_cn: 她的亲切和蔼让每个人都感到自在。
words.en: The quality of being kind, polite, and generous.

words.ex: He made a mistake in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙中犯了一个错误。
words.en: Haste is the quality of doing something quickly, sometimes too quickly so that you are careless and make mistakes.

words.tr: n. 女主人；女房东；女招待；女主持人；
words.ex: The hostess welcomed us with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 女主人微笑着欢迎我们。
words.en: A woman who receives or entertains guests in a social or official capacity; a woman who is in charge of a particular event or place and who welcomes and looks after the people who attend.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: n. 着陆；降落；楼梯平台； v. “land”的现在分词；
words.ex: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场平稳着陆。
words.en: The act of coming to or bringing something to land, especially an aircraft.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.ex: His modesty made everyone like him.
words.ex_cn: 他的谦虚让所有人都喜欢他。
words.en: Modesty is the quality of not being too proud or confident about yourself or your abilities.

words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The naughty boy broke his mother's vase.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的男孩打碎了他妈妈的花瓶。
words.en: If you say that a child is naughty, you mean that they behave badly or do not do what they are told.

words.ex: The two sides started negotiation to solve the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 双方开始了谈判以解决冲突。
words.en: Negotiation is a discussion aimed at reaching an agreement.

words.ex: His constant need for one-upmanship made him unpopular among his colleagues.
words.ex_cn: 他那不断需要高人一等的行为使他在同事中不受欢迎。
words.en: The practice of outdoing or attempting to outdo others, especially in social or professional situations.

words.tr:
n. 离别；分别；分界线；分界处
adj. 离别时的；逝去的
v. 分离；分开；“part”的现在分词
words.ex: He said goodbye with a sad parting smile.
words.ex_cn: 他带着悲伤的告别微笑说了再见。
words.en: The act of leaving or separating from someone or something.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: His politeness made everyone feel welcome.
words.ex_cn: 他的礼貌让每个人都感到受欢迎。
words.en: Politeness is the practical application of good manners or etiquette so as not to offend others.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.ex: His refusal to apologize made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝道歉，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: The act of refusing to do something or to accept something.

words.ex: Her straightforwardness made it easy to understand her intentions.
words.ex_cn: 她的坦率让人很容易理解她的意图。
words.en: the quality of being easy to understand or simple; honesty and directness in behavior or speech

words.ex: He surpassed his brother in math scores.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学成绩上超过了他弟弟。
words.en: If one person or thing surpasses another, the first is better than, or has more of a particular quality than, the second.

words.ex: This broken phone is useless.
words.ex_cn: 这部坏掉的手机毫无用处。
words.en: If something is useless, it is not able to do what it is supposed to do or is not effective.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so forth.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could be mentioned.

words.ex: If you go against the rules, you might get in trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你违反规定，可能会惹上麻烦。
words.en: To oppose or act in contradiction to something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.ex: This rule hold true for all simple cases.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则适用于所有简单的情况。
words.en: If something holds true, it is or remains true, valid, or applicable.

words.ex: He insists on walking to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天步行上学。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.tr: phrase. 许多（后接单数可数名词，表示复数意义）；一个又一个的
words.ex: Many a student fails this test.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生都未能通过这次考试。
words.en: Used to indicate a large number of something, followed by a singular noun.

words.tr: phrase. 给某人添麻烦；使某人受累
words.ex: I don't want to put you to trouble, so I will do it myself.
words.ex_cn: 我不想麻烦你，所以我会自己做。
words.en: To cause inconvenience or difficulty to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 为某人送行；送别某人（通常指到车站、机场等地方）
words.ex: I go to the station to see someone off.
words.ex_cn: 我去车站送别人。
words.en: To accompany someone to the point of departure, such as a train station or airport, to say goodbye.

words.tr: phrase. 送行；为某人送别；（体育中）罚下某人
words.ex: We will send her off at the airport tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将在机场为她送行。
words.en: To cause someone to leave, especially with a formal or ceremonial gesture; to dismiss someone from a place or position.

words.tr: phrase. 悄悄进入；不知不觉陷入；穿上（衣服）
words.ex: He likes to slip into the room when no one is looking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢趁没人注意时溜进房间。
words.en: To enter a place or a state in a quiet or unnoticed manner.

words.tr: phrase. 掩饰；缓和（矛盾或困难）；使（关系等）平顺
words.ex: He tried to smooth over the conflict between the two parties.
words.ex_cn: 他试图平息双方之间的冲突。
words.en: To make a problem or disagreement seem less serious or easier to deal with.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；出发；起初从事（某事）
words.ex: He starts out as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始是一名老师。
words.en: To begin a journey or a process.

words.ex: He takes pride in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助别人为荣。
words.en: To feel a sense of satisfaction or pleasure in one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions, or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.ex: He spoke with regard to the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新规定。
words.en: Used to introduce the subject that one is going to talk or write about.

chapters.name: Unit 7 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: His answer was apt for the question.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答对这个问题很恰当。
words.en: If someone is apt to do something, they often do it and so it is likely that they will do it again.

words.ex: The child ate a piece of candy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后吃了一块糖果。
words.en: Candy is a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate, often eaten as a treat.

words.ex: He eats celery every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他每天午餐都吃芹菜。
words.en: Celery is a vegetable with long pale green stalks. It is eaten raw in salads or cooked as a vegetable.

words.tr: n. 玉米穗轴；雄天鹅；短腿壮马；小圆块
words.ex: The farmer used the cob to feed the pigs.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用玉米穗轴喂猪。
words.en: A cob is a male swan, a round loaf of bread, or a type of horse that is short and sturdy.

words.tr:
n. 相反；
adj. 相反的；
words.ex: The contrary of hot is cold.
words.ex_cn: 热的相反是冷。
words.en: If you say that something is true contrary to other people's beliefs or opinions, you are emphasizing that it is true and that they are wrong.

words.ex: It is customary to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是习惯做法。
words.en: Something that is customary is normal because it is the way something is usually done.

words.ex: He felt embarrassment when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前绊倒时感到窘迫。
words.en: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

words.ex: Everyone deserves equality in education.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都应享有教育平等。
words.en: Equality is the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, or opportunities.

words.ex: She added lettuce to her sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 她在三明治里加了莴苣。
words.en: Lettuce is a plant with large green leaves that is eaten in salads.

words.ex: I like coffee, and she likes it likewise.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢。
words.en: You use likewise when you are comparing two methods, states, or situations and saying that they are similar.

words.ex: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸巾擦了擦嘴。
words.en: A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to protect your clothes and to wipe your mouth and fingers.

words.ex: She eats olive every day with bread.
words.ex_cn: 她每天和面包一起吃橄榄。
words.en: An olive is a small oval fruit with a hard stone and bitter flesh, green when unripe and bluish black when ripe, used as food and as a source of oil.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.tr: v. 逗留过久，停留超过（时间）
words.ex: She decided to overstay her welcome at her friend's house.
words.ex_cn: 她决定在她朋友家逗留过久。
words.en: To stay longer than the allowed or expected time.

words.ex: This town has a peculiar custom of dancing at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有一个独特的午夜跳舞习俗。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as peculiar, you think that they are strange or unusual, sometimes in an unpleasant way.

words.ex: He said a prayer before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前做了一次祈祷。
words.en: A prayer is a form of religious practice in which people communicate with a deity or spirit, often to ask for help or to give thanks.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.ex: He eats a radish for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个萝卜。
words.en: A radish is a small, round or elongated vegetable with a sharp taste, which is usually eaten raw in salads.

words.tr: adj. 敏感的；感情脆弱的；体贴的；善解人意的；
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: If you are sensitive to other people's needs, problems, or feelings, you understand and are aware of them.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: She polished the silverware before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她在晚餐前擦拭了银器。
words.en: Silverware refers to items made of silver, especially tableware such as knives, forks, and spoons.

words.tr:
v. 溢出；溅出
n. 溢出；溅出
words.ex: He spilled milk on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶洒在了地上。
words.en: To cause or allow (a liquid, powder, etc.) to flow or fall out of a container, usually by accident.

words.ex: He cleaned the room thoroughly.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底地打扫了房间。
words.en: In a thorough manner; completely and carefully.

words.ex: He gave a thoughtful answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个深思的答案。
words.en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

chapters.name: Unit 7 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 倾向于做某事的；容易做某事的
words.ex: He is apt to forget his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他容易忘带钥匙。
words.en: Having a natural tendency or likelihood to behave or happen in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 处在最佳状态；在全盛时期
words.ex: She is at her best when she sings on stage.
words.ex_cn: 当她站在舞台上唱歌时，她是最出色的。
words.en: If you are at your best, you are performing or behaving as well as you are able to.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.tr: phrase. v. 跟随某人的领导；照某人的做法行事
words.ex: You should follow someone's lead and do your homework first.
words.ex_cn: 你应该听从别人的榜样，先做作业。
words.en: To follow someone's lead means to follow their guidance or example in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 效仿某人；以某人为榜样
words.ex: He follows his brother's example and works hard every day.
words.ex_cn: 他以他哥哥为榜样，每天都努力工作。
words.en: To do the same as someone else has done, especially because they have been successful or have set a good example.

words.tr: phrase. 把某事留给别人处理；将某事交由他人负责
words.ex: I will leave the decision to someone else.
words.ex_cn: 我会把决定留给别人。
words.en: To allow someone else to make a decision or take responsibility for something.

words.ex: He says he likes quiet, on the contrary, he always listens to loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢安静，相反，他总是听大声的音乐。
words.en: You use 'on the contrary' when you are contradicting what has just been said or implied, or making a contrast between two things.

words.ex: The project is under way.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正在进行中。
words.en: If an activity is under way, it has already started.

chapters.name: Unit 7 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: The decision was made in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定是按照规则做出的。
words.en: Agreement or harmony; conformity.

words.tr:
adj. 不锋利的；耿直的
v. 使变钝
words.ex: The knife is blunt and cannot cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀不锋利，切不动纸。
words.en: If you are blunt, you say exactly what you think without trying to be polite.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: She bought a bouquet of flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一束花。
words.en: A bouquet is a bunch of flowers that is attractively arranged, especially one that is given to someone as a present.

words.tr: n. 雕刻品；雕刻图案； v. 雕刻；“carve”的现在分词；
words.ex: The museum displayed a beautiful wooden carving.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展示了一件精美的木雕品。
words.en: A carving is an object or design that has been cut out of a material such as wood or stone.

words.ex: She bought a chrysanthemum for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲买了一朵菊花。
words.en: A chrysanthemum is a large, showy flower that is commonly found in gardens and used in floral arrangements. It is known for its wide variety of colors and forms.

words.tr:
n. 忏悔室；告解所
adj. 自白的；忏悔的
words.ex: He went to the confessional to tell his sins.
words.ex_cn: 他去告解室坦白自己的罪过。
words.en: A confessional is a small, enclosed booth in a church where a priest sits to hear confessions.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: She greeted him customarily with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 她习惯性地对他微笑问候。
words.en: If something is customarily done in a particular way, it is usually done in that way.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is inappropriate.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去参加会议是不合适的。
words.en: If you say that something is inappropriate, you are criticizing it because you think it is not suitable for a particular situation or purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 联合的；共同的；
n. 关节；接合处；
words.ex: They signed a joint agreement to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一项联合协议来保护环境。
words.en: A joint is a place where two things are joined together, especially the place where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: She planted a white lily in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种了一朵白色的百合。
words.en: A lily is a plant with large flowers that are often white, but can also be pink, yellow, or purple. Lilies are commonly used in gardens and as cut flowers.

words.ex: He walks slowly to enjoy the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地走，以便欣赏日落。
words.en: If you do something slowly, you do it at a low speed.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.ex: The door is partially open.
words.ex_cn: 门部分开着。
words.en: To a limited degree or in a limited manner; not completely.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: He bought a porcelain cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个瓷杯。
words.en: A hard, white, translucent ceramic that is made by firing a pure clay and then glazing it.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

words.tr: adj. 谚语的；众所周知的；已成话柄的
words.ex: It's a proverbial saying that early to bed makes you healthy.
words.ex_cn: 早睡早起是一个谚语，说这样会让你健康。
words.en: Something that is proverbial is well-known by a lot of people, often because it is a typical example of something.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.ex: The government kept the mission in secrecy.
words.ex_cn: 政府将这次任务保密。
words.en: Secrecy is the practice of keeping something secret, or the state of being secret.

words.ex: He wore a sexy shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件性感的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something as sexy, you mean that it is attractive in a way that suggests sex or sexual activity.

words.ex: The red light signifies stop.
words.ex_cn: 红灯表示停止。
words.en: If an event, a sign, or a symbol signifies something, it is a sign of that thing or represents that thing.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: The poem uses symbolism to show love and loss.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用象征手法来表现爱与失去。
words.en: Symbolism is the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.tr: v. 使脱去衣服，剥光( unclothe的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The model was unclothed for the art class.
words.ex_cn: 模特为艺术课脱去了衣服。
words.en: Not wearing any clothes.

words.ex: She wore a simple white undergarment.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件简单的白色内衣。
words.en: An undergarment is a piece of clothing that you wear next to your skin, under other clothes.

words.ex: He will unwrap the gift tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会拆开礼物。
words.en: To remove the wrapping or cover from something.

words.tr: adj. 出于好心的；善意的
words.ex: He gave her advice, but it was well-intentioned.
words.ex_cn: 他给了她建议，但本意是好的。
words.en: If you say that a person or their actions are well-intentioned, you mean that they intend to be helpful or kind but they are unsuccessful or cause problems.

chapters.name: Unit 7 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He acted in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他按照规则行事。
words.en: If something is done in accordance with a particular rule or system, it is done in the way that the rule or system says that it should be done.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.tr: phrase. 使缓和；使温和；降低强度或锋芒
words.ex: Please tone down the music, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音乐声调小一点，太大声了。
words.en: To make something less forceful, intense, or extreme; to moderate.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Part Two New Words

words.tr: v. 感到极度焦虑；折磨；苦苦思索
words.ex: He agonizes over his decision every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都为自己的决定而痛苦挣扎。
words.en: To agonize over something means to spend a lot of time worrying and being anxious about it.

words.ex: He amass wealth by working hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作积累财富。
words.en: If you amass something such as money or information, you gradually collect a large amount of it.

words.tr: v. 向往；渴望；追求；立志
words.ex: He aspires to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他向往成为一名医生。
words.en: If you aspire to something, you have a strong desire to achieve it or attain it.

words.ex: The company is bankrupt after losing all its money.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司失去所有钱后破产了。
words.en: If a person or a company is bankrupt, they have been declared by a court of law to be unable to pay their debts.

words.tr: n. 破产；倒闭；无偿付能力
words.ex: The company filed for bankruptcy last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年申请了破产。
words.en: Bankruptcy is a legal status of a person or other entity that cannot repay the debts it owes to creditors.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: The car dealer sold me a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 汽车经销商卖给我一辆新自行车。
words.en: A dealer is a person whose business involves buying and selling things.

words.ex: He will depart tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他明天早上离开。
words.en: If you depart from a place, you leave it and start a journey to another place.

words.tr: adj. 难以捉摸的；不易被抓获（觉察、理解或记忆）的；
words.ex: The truth remained elusive.
words.ex_cn: 真相难以捉摸。
words.en: Difficult to find, catch, or achieve; difficult to remember or understand.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the ewe every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂那只母羊。
words.en: A ewe is a female sheep.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.ex: The team works in harmony.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队合作得很和谐。
words.en: Harmony is the pleasant combination of different notes of music played at the same time. It can also refer to a situation in which people are peaceful and agree with each other, or when things seem right or suitable together.

words.tr:
n. 贮藏物；隐藏物
v. 贮藏；囤积
words.ex: The treasure hunter found a hoard of gold coins.
words.ex_cn: 寻宝者发现了一堆金币。
words.en: If you hoard things such as food or money, you save or store them, often in secret, because they are valuable or important to you.

words.tr: n. 发明家；发明者；创造者；
words.ex: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
words.ex_cn: 托马斯·爱迪生是一位著名的发明家。
words.en: An inventor is a person who has invented something, or whose job is to invent things.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the lamb every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂羔羊。
words.en: A lamb is a young sheep.

words.ex: He spoke quietly lest he wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他低声说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If you do something lest something unpleasant should happen, you do it to try to prevent the unpleasant thing from happening.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.tr: n. 食品贮藏室；食品贮藏柜
words.ex: She keeps cookies in the pantry.
words.ex_cn: 她把饼干放在食品储藏室里。
words.en: A pantry is a small room or closet in a house, usually near the kitchen, where food, dishes, linens, and provisions are stored.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr: adj. 一文不名的；穷困的；
words.ex: He was penniless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后一文不名。
words.en: If someone is penniless, they have no money at all.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.ex: He decided to test-drive the new model before making a purchase.
words.ex_cn: 他在购买前决定试驾一下新车型。
words.en: To test-drive a vehicle means to drive it in order to see if you want to buy it.

words.ex: He felt a strong thirst after running.
words.ex_cn: 跑步后他感到强烈的口渴。
words.en: A strong desire to drink something, especially water.

words.tr: n. 四轮运货马车；敞篷货车；
words.ex: The farmer used a wooden wagon to carry crops.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用一辆木制四轮运货马车运送庄稼。
words.en: A wagon is a vehicle with four wheels, usually pulled by horses or oxen, used for transporting goods.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.tr: phrase. v. 减少；削减（开支、用量等）
words.ex: We need to cut back on our expenses.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少开支。
words.en: To reduce the amount of something, especially in order to save money.

words.ex: He tries to do good by helping his neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他通过帮助邻居来行善。
words.en: To do good means to perform acts that are beneficial to others or to society.

words.tr: phrase. 就那件事而言；而且；也；同样地
words.ex: I don't like coffee, and for that matter, I don't like tea either.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，就那件事而言，我也不喜欢茶。
words.en: used to indicate that a statement applies to another subject just as much as to the one already mentioned

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.
