words.tr: phrase. 再投资：将利润再投入到企业中。
words.ex: The company decided to plow back its profits into research and development.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定将其利润再投资于研发。
words.en: To reinvest profits back into the business or project.

words.ex: He will point out the mistake in the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将指出这道数学题中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's attention to a particular fact or detail.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: The farmer feeds the calf every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂小牛。
words.en: A calf is a young cow or bull. It can also refer to the fleshy part of the back of the human leg below the knee.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. “concern”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book is concerning climate change.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于气候变化的。
words.en: If something is concerning, it causes you to feel concerned about it.

words.ex: The boy disobeyed his mother.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩违抗了他妈妈。
words.en: If you disobey someone or something, you deliberately do not do what they say or what they tell you to do.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: He duly submitted his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他适时地按时交了作业。
words.en: If something is duly done, it is done in the correct way or at the correct time; properly.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr:
n. 过量；过度；超过；
adj. 多余的；
words.ex: The excess of sugar in his diet caused health problems.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食中糖分过量导致了健康问题。
words.en: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

words.ex: The farmer piled up fodder for the cows.
words.ex_cn: 农夫为奶牛堆了一堆饲料。
words.en: Fodder is food that is given to cows, horses, and other animals.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: The farmer raises fowl for eggs and meat.
words.ex_cn: 农民饲养家禽来获取鸡蛋和肉。
words.en: A fowl is a bird, especially one that can be eaten as food, such as a chicken, duck, or turkey.

words.tr: v. 伤心；悲痛；使悲痛；使伤心
words.ex: He grieves for his lost dog.
words.ex_cn: 他为失去的狗感到悲痛。
words.en: To feel or express deep sorrow or distress, especially because of someone's death.

words.ex: The horse eats hay every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这匹马每天早上吃干草。
words.en: Hay is grass which has been cut and dried so that it can be used to feed animals.

words.ex: Parents shouldn't indulge their children's bad habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母不应该放任孩子的坏习惯。
words.en: To indulge means to allow yourself or someone else to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you.

words.ex: The virus can infect people quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒能迅速感染人。
words.en: To infect someone or something means to cause them to have a disease or illness.

words.ex: The mare grazed quietly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 那匹母马在田野里安静地吃草。
words.en: A mare is an adult female horse.

words.ex: He felt deep misery after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的痛苦。
words.en: Misery is a state of great unhappiness and emotional distress.

words.ex: He likes reading books; moreover, he writes his own stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读书；此外，他还写自己的故事。
words.en: You use moreover to introduce a piece of information that adds to or supports the previous statement.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: The parable of the Good Samaritan teaches compassion and kindness.
words.ex_cn: 好撒玛利亚人的寓言教导了同情和善良。
words.en: A simple story used to illustrate a moral or spiritual lesson, as told by Jesus in the Gospels.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.ex: He earned a respectable salary last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年挣了一份可观的薪水。
words.en: Someone or something that is respectable is approved of by society and considered to be morally correct.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: 短语动词。突然大笑起来；忍不住笑出声
words.ex: He told a funny joke and everyone broke out laughing.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了个有趣的笑话，大家都突然大笑起来。
words.en: To suddenly start laughing, usually in a way that is hard to control.

words.tr: 短语动词. 突然大笑起来
words.ex: He told a joke and we burst out laughing.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了个笑话，我们突然大笑起来。
words.en: To suddenly start laughing loudly.

words.tr: phrase. 拥有权力的；当权的；主管的
words.ex: The teacher is in authority in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里拥有权力。
words.en: Having official power or control over others; in a position of command.

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.tr: phrase. 把（女儿）嫁出去；使成婚
words.ex: She was eager to marry off her daughters to wealthy suitors.
words.ex_cn: 她急切地想把女儿嫁给有钱的求婚者。
words.en: If you marry someone off, you arrange for them to get married, often when they are young or when you do not think they can find a partner themselves.

words.tr: phrase. 使沦为；使陷入；把…归结为；把…简化为
words.ex: Heat the sauce until it reduces to a thick liquid.
words.ex_cn: 把酱汁加热，直到它变成浓稠的液体。
words.en: To bring something to a smaller or simpler form; to cause someone to be in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: He rose to his feet when the teacher entered the room.
words.ex_cn: 老师进教室时，他站了起来。
words.en: To stand up, especially after sitting or kneeling.

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.tr: phrase. 如此之甚，以至于（用于强调程度导致的结果）
words.ex: He was very tired, so much so that he fell asleep immediately.
words.ex_cn: 他非常累，以至于他立刻就睡着了。
words.en: to such an extent that

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.tr: adj. 和蔼可亲的；亲切友好的
words.ex: He is an amiable man who always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个和蔼可亲的人，总是面带微笑。
words.en: Someone who is amiable is friendly and pleasant to be with.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.ex: He wiped the sweat from his brow.
words.ex_cn: 他擦去了额头上的汗水。
words.en: The brow refers to the eyebrow or the forehead, and can also denote the top edge of a steep place such as a cliff.

words.tr: n. 一束；一串；一群；大量
words.ex: A bunch of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A bunch of things is a group of them. A bunch of people is a group of them who are together or who are connected in some way.

words.tr: n. 分（菲律宾以及拉丁美洲的货币单位）
words.ex: He had only a few centavos in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里只有几个分币。
words.en: A monetary unit in various countries, especially in Latin America, equivalent to one hundredth of the basic unit.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: He listened to his conscience and told the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他听从了良心，说出了真相。
words.en: Your conscience is the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is right or wrong.

words.ex: He felt contentment after a simple dinner with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他在与家人共进一顿简单的晚餐后感到满足。
words.en: Contentment is a feeling of happiness and satisfaction.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr:
n. 畜栏；车阵
v. 关进畜栏；把人关起来
words.ex: The cows are kept in a corral at night.
words.ex_cn: 牛晚上被关在畜栏里。
words.en: A corral is an enclosure or pen for livestock, especially cattle or horses, on a farm or ranch.

words.tr:
n. 冠；顶部
v. 到达顶部；到达最高点
words.ex: The rooster has a bright red crest.
words.ex_cn: 公鸡有一个鲜红的冠。
words.en: The highest part of a hill or mountain; the top of a wave; a tuft or growth of feathers or skin on the head of a bird or other animal.

words.tr:
n. 曲柄杖；钩；弯曲处；骗子
v. （使）弯曲；使成钩状
words.ex: The old man walked with a wooden crook.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人拿着一根木制曲柄杖走路。
words.en: A crook is a person who is dishonest or a criminal, or it can refer to a bend or curve in something.

words.ex: The birds sing at daybreak.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时鸣叫。
words.en: The time in the morning when light first appears; dawn.

words.ex: He drew a dot on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个小圆点。
words.en: A dot is a very small round mark, for example one that is used as the top part of the letter 'i', as a full stop, or as a decimal point.

words.tr:
n. 布帘；垂下的褶皱状
v. 盖上褶缀的布；将（织物）悬挂；懒散地垂着
words.ex: The blue drape covered the window completely.
words.ex_cn: 蓝色的布帘完全遮住了窗户。
words.en: To drape something means to arrange it in a loose, flowing way, especially fabric or clothing.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.tr:
n. 冰雹；
v. 把…誉为；
words.ex: The hail broke many car windows.
words.ex_cn: 冰雹打碎了许多汽车窗户。
words.en: Hail is small balls of ice that fall like rain from the sky. It can also mean to call out to someone in order to attract their attention, or to praise someone enthusiastically.

words.ex: The hailstone was as big as a golf ball.
words.ex_cn: 这个雹块有高尔夫球那么大。
words.en: A hailstone is a small, hard ball of ice that falls from the sky like rain.

words.ex: The hailstorm caused significant damage to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 雹暴对农作物造成了严重损害。
words.en: A hailstorm is a storm in which hail falls.

words.tr: adv. 衷心地；热诚地；劲头十足地；
words.ex: He laughed heartily at the joke.
words.ex_cn: 他听了这个笑话后衷心地大笑。
words.en: If you do something heartily, you do it with a lot of enthusiasm or energy.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.tr: adv. 密切地；亲密地；谙熟地；
words.ex: They are intimately connected by family ties.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过家庭关系密切相连。
words.en: In a way that involves a close link or relationship; closely.

words.ex: She added some kidney beans to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一些菜豆。
words.en: A kidney bean is a type of bean that is shaped like a kidney and is commonly used in cooking.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.ex: The locust flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 蝗虫飞过了田野。
words.en: A locust is a large insect that lives in hot countries and flies in large groups, destroying crops.

words.ex: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使司机系安全带。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty, etc., makes it necessary.

words.tr: n. 比索（一种外国货币单位）
words.ex: The exchange rate for the peso has dropped significantly.
words.ex_cn: 比索的汇率已经大幅下降。
words.en: The peso is the unit of money used in several Latin American countries, including Mexico, Argentina, and the Philippines.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.ex: The postmaster delivered the letter yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 邮局局长昨天送来了这封信。
words.en: A postmaster is the person in charge of a post office, responsible for its operation and the management of its staff.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: The resolution of the conflict took many meetings.
words.ex_cn: 这个冲突的解决花了多次会议。
words.en: A resolution is a formal decision made at a meeting by the vote of the people who are there. It can also refer to a firm decision to do or not to do something.

words.ex: The farmer decided to resow the field after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 农民决定在暴风雨后重新播种这块田地。
words.en: To sow again, especially to plant seeds again in the same area where previous planting has failed or to improve the yield.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.tr: adj. 悲伤的；使人伤心的
words.ex: He looked sorrowful after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 失去狗后，他看起来很悲伤。
words.en: Feeling or showing sadness; mournful.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

chapters.name: Unit 8 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 观看；面向；旁观；看待
words.ex: They look on while the children play.
words.ex_cn: 他们看着孩子们玩耍。
words.en: To watch something happen without getting involved.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

chapters.name: Unit 9 Part Two New Words

words.tr:
n. 青少年；
adj. 青少年的；
words.ex: The adolescent walked to school with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年和朋友们一起走路去上学。
words.en: An adolescent is a young person who is developing into an adult.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.ex: The buyer paid for the car last week.
words.ex_cn: 买方上周支付了车款。
words.en: A buyer is a person who buys something, especially from a shop or another person.

words.ex: The course covers the principles of buymanship and effective negotiation techniques.
words.ex_cn: 该课程涵盖了采购学的原理和有效的谈判技巧。
words.en: The skill or ability in buying or selecting purchases.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.ex: He gave careful consideration to his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的决定进行了仔细考虑。
words.en: Consideration is the process of giving careful thought to something before making a decision or taking action. It also refers to the quality of being thoughtful towards the needs and feelings of others.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；美容品；“cosmetic”的复数；
words.ex: She buys cosmetics at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 她在药店买化妆品。
words.en: Substances or treatments used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: He majors in economics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学主修经济学。
words.en: Economics is the study of the way in which money, industry, and trade are organized in a society.

words.tr: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的；
words.ex: This is an educational video for children.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个为儿童制作的教育视频。
words.en: Educational means relating to education or the process of education.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.ex: She wore beautiful jewelry to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了漂亮的珠宝去参加派对。
words.en: Jewelry refers to decorative items worn for personal adornment, such as brooches, rings, necklaces, earrings, and bracelets. Jewelry may be attached to the body or the clothes, and the term is restricted to durable ornaments, excluding flowers for example.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.tr: n. 市场商人；市场上的卖主
words.ex: The marketer sold toys to children during the holiday sale.
words.ex_cn: 这位市场商人在假期促销期间向孩子们销售玩具。
words.en: A marketer is someone whose job involves marketing products or services.

words.ex: The marketplace is full of fresh fruits and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 市场上摆满了新鲜的水果和蔬菜。
words.en: A marketplace is an area in a town where a public market is held, or a situation or arena in which commercial dealings are conducted.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.tr: adj. 以…为导向的； v. “orient”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The program is student-oriented.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是以学生为导向的。
words.en: If someone is oriented towards or oriented to a particular thing or person, they are mainly concerned with that thing or person.

words.ex: Parental love is very important for children.
words.ex_cn: 父母的爱对孩子非常重要。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a parent or parents.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: The purchaser paid cash for the car.
words.ex_cn: 买主用现金支付了这辆车。
words.en: A purchaser is a person who buys something.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: This room is relatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with other similar things or with what you expect.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.ex: The respondent answered all the questions honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这位调查对象诚实地回答了所有问题。
words.en: A respondent is someone who replies to something such as a survey or set of questions.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.tr: adj. 青少年的；十来岁的；
words.ex: Teenage boys often like playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 青少年男孩通常喜欢打篮球。
words.en: Teenage is used to describe someone who is between the ages of 13 and 19, or something that is related to or typical of this age group.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.ex: He was a dedicated trier, always willing to experiment with new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个执着的实验者，总是愿意尝试新想法。
words.en: A trier is someone who makes an effort to do something, especially when it is difficult.

chapters.name: Unit 9 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: He left home prior to sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他在日出前离开了家。
words.en: Before a particular time or event.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: He tends to arrive late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是迟到上课。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they often do it.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: Children find amusement in playing games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩游戏时感到快乐。
words.en: Amusement is the feeling that you have when you think that something is funny or entertaining.

words.ex: The kitchen has a new washing appliance.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有一台新的洗衣机。
words.en: An appliance is a device or machine that is used to perform a particular task, especially in the home.

words.ex: The rule applies broadly across all schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个规定广泛适用于所有学校。
words.en: In a general way; without considering details.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: Please go to the checkout to pay for your groceries.
words.ex_cn: 请去付款处支付你的杂货。
words.en: The act of paying for goods or services in a store, or the place where this is done.

words.ex: Each cell has 46 chromosomes.
words.ex_cn: 每个细胞有46条染色体。
words.en: A chromosome is a thread-like structure of nucleic acids and protein found in the nucleus of most living cells, carrying genetic information in the form of genes.

words.tr: adj. 专注的；专用的；献身的； v. 奉献；“dedicate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is dedicated to his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他专注于学习。
words.en: If you say that someone is dedicated to something, you approve of the fact that they have committed to it and are willing to give a lot of time and energy to it.

words.tr: v. 吞食；吞噬；狼吞虎咽地吃；如饥似渴地看
words.ex: The dog devoured the meat quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗很快地把肉吃光了。
words.en: To eat something quickly and eagerly, especially because you are very hungry; to destroy something quickly and completely.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr:
n. （鸟或羊）群；（人）群；
v. 聚集；群集；
words.ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过田野。
words.en: A flock is a group of birds, sheep, or goats, or a large group of people. It can also refer to a soft material for stuffing cushions, quilts, etc., made from wool or cotton. As a verb, it means to gather or move in a flock.

words.tr: n. 赌博； v. “gamble”的现在分词；
words.ex: He lost all his money on gambling.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都输在了赌博上。
words.en: Gambling is the act of betting money on the outcome of a game, a contest, or an uncertain event.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The makeup of the team includes students from five countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的组成包括来自五个国家的学生。
words.en: Makeup refers to substances applied to the face to improve or alter the appearance, or the way in which something is composed or arranged.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他去商场买衣服。
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.ex: The store sells cheap merchandise.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售廉价商品。
words.en: Goods to be bought and sold.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: He faced ridicule for wearing old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为穿旧衣服而遭到嘲笑。
words.en: To ridicule someone or something means to make fun of them in an unkind way.

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: He bought a gift for his spouse.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的配偶买了一份礼物。
words.en: A spouse is a person's partner in marriage.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: I suspect it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜想明天会下雨。
words.en: If you suspect someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you believe that they have done it, although you have no proof.

words.tr: adj. 引起疲劳的；累人的； v. “tire”的现在分词；
words.ex: The long walk was tiring.
words.ex_cn: 这次长时间的散步让人感到疲惫。
words.en: If you describe something as tiring, you mean that it makes you tired so that you want to rest or sleep.

words.ex: He felt unappreciated after working hard for months.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作了几个月，却感到不被赏识。
words.en: If someone or something is unappreciated, their good qualities or achievements are not recognized or valued by others.

words.ex: It was unfortunate that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他没赶上公交车，真是不幸。
words.en: If you describe someone as unfortunate, you mean that something unpleasant or unlucky has happened to them. You can also describe the unpleasant things that happen to them as unfortunate.

words.tr: adj. 不愿意的；不情愿的；
words.ex: He was unwilling to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you are unwilling to do something, you do not want to do it and will not agree to do it.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He is at best a beginner in cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在烹饪方面最多是个初学者。
words.en: At best is used to indicate the most positive or optimistic scenario or outcome, often implying that the actual situation may be worse.

words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.ex: He looks happy, but in reality, he is sad.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来很开心，但事实上，他很难过。
words.en: used to emphasize what is actually the case, as opposed to what people might think

words.ex: In theory, the plan works well.
words.ex_cn: 理论上，这个计划效果很好。
words.en: If you say that something is true in theory, you mean that it is supposed to be true according to a set of ideas or principles, but in practice it may not be true.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.ex: They accused him of stealing the money.
words.ex_cn: 他们指控他偷了钱。
words.en: If you accuse someone of doing something wrong or dishonest, you say or tell them that you believe that they did it.

words.ex: It is advantageous to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 早起是有利的。
words.en: If something is advantageous to you, it is likely to benefit you.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊叹。
words.en: If you say that something is breathtaking, you mean that it is extremely beautiful or amazing.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.tr: adj. 迷人的；娇媚的； v. “charm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The little village is charming with its flowers and quiet streets.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄以其花朵和宁静的街道而迷人。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as charming, you mean they are very pleasant and attractive.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.tr: n. 清洁工人；清洁工具； adj. 更洁净的；更干净的；“clean”的比较级；
words.ex: The cleaner sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工人每天早上扫地。
words.en: A cleaner is a person whose job is to clean a place or a substance used for cleaning.

words.ex: He wore a decent shirt to the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件像样的衬衫去面试。
words.en: Decent is used to describe something which is considered to be of an acceptable standard or quality.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.ex: The gang tried to extort money from the shop owner.
words.ex_cn: 这个帮派试图向店主敲诈钱财。
words.en: To extort is to obtain something, especially money, through force, threats, or other unfair means.

words.ex: He bought an extravagant car that cost too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆奢侈的车，价格太贵了。
words.en: Spending much more than is necessary or wise; excessively expensive.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.ex: She put the ice cream in the freezer.
words.ex_cn: 她把冰淇淋放进冷冻柜里。
words.en: A freezer is a device that is used to store food at very low temperatures in order to preserve it.

words.ex: My grandchild loves to play with me.
words.ex_cn: 我的孙子/孙女喜欢和我一起玩。
words.en: A grandchild is the child of your son or daughter.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: His impertinence made the teacher angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的无礼让老师生气了。
words.en: Impertinence refers to a lack of respect or rudeness, especially towards someone who is older or in a position of authority.

words.tr:
v. 侮辱；辱骂
n. 侮辱；辱骂
words.ex: He insulted her with rude words.
words.ex_cn: 他用粗鲁的话侮辱了她。
words.en: To insult someone means to say or do something that is rude or offensive.

words.tr:
v. 看；看上去；
n. 看；
words.ex: He looks at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看着天空。
words.en: To direct your eyes in a particular direction.

words.ex: The murderer was caught by the police.
words.ex_cn: 杀人犯被警察抓住了。
words.en: A murderer is a person who has committed the crime of murder.

words.tr: n. 不抽烟的人；禁止吸烟列车车厢
words.ex: He is a non-smoker and never drinks alcohol.
words.ex_cn: 他是个不吸烟的人，从不喝酒。
words.en: A non-smoker is a person who does not smoke.

words.ex: The toy store sells many novelty items for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具店出售许多为儿童设计的新奇物品。
words.en: The quality of being new, original, or unusual; something new, original, or unusual.

words.ex: He follows the orthodox religious practices.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循正统的宗教习俗。
words.en: Orthodox beliefs, methods, or systems are ones which are accepted or used by most people.

words.tr: adj. 义愤填膺的；愤怒的；震惊的； v. “outrage”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The crowd was outraged by the unfair decision.
words.ex_cn: 人群对这个不公平的决定义愤填膺。
words.en: If you are outraged by something, you are extremely shocked and angry about it.

words.ex: He eats a pea from his plate.
words.ex_cn: 他从盘子里吃了一颗豌豆。
words.en: A pea is a small, round, green seed which is eaten as a vegetable and which is formed in a pod on a climbing plant.

words.tr: n. 辨戈（匈牙利原货币单位）
words.ex: The price of the item was 100 pengos.
words.ex_cn: 这件物品的价格是100辨戈。
words.en: A former monetary unit of Hungary, used before the introduction of the forint.

words.tr: n. 领取退休、养老金或抚恤金的人；
words.ex: The pensioner walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位领取养老金的人每天早上都遛狗。
words.en: A pensioner is someone who receives a pension, especially a retirement pension.

words.tr: v. 恳求；辩护；答辩；以…为理由
words.ex: He pleaded for help when he was lost.
words.ex_cn: 当他迷路时，他恳求帮助。
words.en: If you plead with someone to do something, you ask them in an intense, emotional way to do it.

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.ex: He likes to roller-skate in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里滑旱冰。
words.en: To roller-skate means to move on roller skates, which are shoes or boots with four small wheels attached to the bottom, allowing the wearer to glide smoothly over a surface.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.tr: adj. 心智健全的；头脑清醒的；明智的
words.ex: He is still sane after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他仍然神志清醒。
words.en: If someone is sane, they are able to think and behave in a normal and rational manner.

words.ex: I saw a bird fly over the house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一只鸟飞过房子。
words.en: A saw is a tool consisting of a tough blade, wire, or chain with a hard toothed edge. It is used to cut through material, very often wood, though sometimes metal or stone. The cut is made by placing the toothed edge against the material and moving it forcefully forth and less forcefully back or continuously forward.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.tr: n. 先令（英国1971年以前的辅币，等于12便士）
words.ex: He paid five shillings for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五个先令买面包。
words.en: A shilling was a coin used in Britain before the decimalization of the currency in 1971, worth one twentieth of a pound or twelve pence.

words.ex: The new house has a spacious living room.
words.ex_cn: 这所新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。
words.en: A spacious room, building, or place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

words.ex: This tool is specially designed for children.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具是专门为儿童设计的。
words.en: In a special manner; particularly.

words.ex: The honey is sticky.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是黏的。
words.en: Something that is sticky is covered with a substance that things stick to.

words.ex: She decorated the room very tastily.
words.ex_cn: 她把房间装饰得非常有品味。
words.en: In a manner that is pleasing to the taste; deliciously.

words.ex: He brushes his teeth with toothpaste every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用牙膏刷牙。
words.en: A thick, soft, moist substance used on a toothbrush for cleaning the teeth.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.ex: It is unnecessary to bring an umbrella today.
words.ex_cn: 今天带伞是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as unnecessary, you mean that it is not needed or does not have to be done, and often that it may be harmful or undesirable.

words.ex: He was utterly surprised by the news.
words.ex_cn: 他全然没想到这个消息。
words.en: completely or totally

words.ex: He vaguely remembered the name.
words.ex_cn: 他模糊地记得这个名字。
words.en: If you describe something as vaguely, you mean that it is not clear, distinct, or definite.

words.tr:
conj. 于是；因此
adv. 于是；因此
words.ex: He finished his speech, whereupon the audience burst into applause.
words.ex_cn: 他结束了演讲，于是观众爆发出热烈的掌声。
words.en: Conjunction. Immediately after which.

chapters.name: Unit 9 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 指责；控告（某人做某事），后接of引导的介词短语说明被指控的内容
words.ex: He accused her of stealing his book.
words.ex_cn: 他指责她偷了他的书。
words.en: To charge someone with a fault or offense; to blame someone for something.

words.tr: phrase. 尽管如此；仍然；还是
words.ex: He didn't study, but all the same, he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，但尽管如此，他还是通过了考试。
words.en: Despite that; nevertheless.

words.ex: He cut off the power during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴期间切断了电源。
words.en: To stop the supply of something, or to stop something from continuing.

words.tr: phrase. v. 喜欢上某物；被某事吸引；受骗上当
words.ex: He fell for something silly and lost his money.
words.ex_cn: 他上当受骗，失去了他的钱。
words.en: To be deceived by something or to develop strong feelings of love for someone.

words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 大量地；散装地；成批地
words.ex: He buys apples in bulk to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他批量购买苹果以节省金钱。
words.en: In large quantities or amounts, not divided into separate units.

words.tr: phrase. 不妨；倒不如；还是…为好
words.ex: Since we're already here, we might as well stay for the show.
words.ex_cn: 既然我们已经在这里了，不妨留下来看表演。
words.en: Used to suggest that something should be done or accepted because there is no good reason not to do it.

words.ex: He forgot his keys, but just as well, the door was open.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了带钥匙，但也好，门是开着的。
words.en: Used to say that it is a good thing that something happened or was done because if it had not, the situation would be worse.

chapters.name: Unit 10 Part Two New Words

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: His behavioral changes worried his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为变化让他的父母担心。
words.en: Relating to the way in which someone behaves.

words.ex: He rubbed his belly after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后揉了揉腹部。
words.en: The belly is the front part of a person's or animal's body between the chest and the legs.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: He has a chronic cough that lasts for months.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个持续数月的慢性咳嗽。
words.en: A chronic illness or condition lasts for a long time and cannot be cured, but it can usually be controlled.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.tr: v. 赋予能量；使精力充沛；激励
words.ex: Coffee helps me energize in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 咖啡帮助我在早上恢复活力。
words.en: To energize someone means to give them the enthusiasm, determination, and energy to do something.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.ex: Rain can hinder our plan to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 雨天会妨碍我们去徒步旅行的计划。
words.en: If something hinders you, it makes it more difficult for you to do something or make progress.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: Vaccines help build immunity against diseases.
words.ex_cn: 疫苗有助于增强对疾病的免疫力。
words.en: Immunity is the state of being immune from or insusceptible to a particular disease or the legal status of being exempt from certain obligations or penalties.

words.tr: n. 免疫传递介质；免疫传递因子
words.ex: The study focused on the role of immunotransmitter in modulating immune responses.
words.ex_cn: 该研究聚焦于免疫传递介质在调节免疫反应中的作用。
words.en: A substance that transmits or carries an immune response.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: He practices mindfulness to focus on his breathing.
words.ex_cn: 他练习注意自己的呼吸。
words.en: Mindfulness is the practice of purposely focusing your attention on the present moment and accepting it without judgment.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.tr: n. 神经递质；神经传导物质
words.ex: The release of neurotransmitters in the brain affects mood and behavior.
words.ex_cn: 大脑中神经递质的释放会影响情绪和行为。
words.en: A neurotransmitter is a chemical substance that is released at the end of a nerve fiber by the arrival of a nerve impulse and, by diffusing across the synapse or junction, effects the transfer of the impulse to another nerve fiber, a muscle fiber, or some other structure.

words.tr: n. 新结婚的人；新婚夫妇
words.ex: The newlywed couple went on a beach vacation.
words.ex_cn: 这对新婚夫妇去海滩度假了。
words.en: A newlywed is a person who has recently married.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: He is pessimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持悲观态度。
words.en: If someone is pessimistic, they expect that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result.

words.ex: The receptor detects the signal from the hormone.
words.ex_cn: 受体检测激素的信号。
words.en: A receptor is a cell or a group of cells that receives stimuli.

words.tr:
n. 释放；发布；
v. 释放；发布；
words.ex: The release of the prisoner made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 囚犯的释放让每个人都高兴。
words.en: To release something means to let it go or to allow it to be free, or to make something available to the public.

words.ex: Breathing deeply helps with respiration.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于呼吸。
words.en: The process of breathing, which involves inhaling oxygen and exhaling carbon dioxide.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.tr: adj. 有节奏的；有韵律的；
words.ex: The children danced to the rhythmic beat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们随着有节奏的节拍跳舞。
words.en: A rhythmic sound or movement has a clear and regular pattern that is repeated.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: The storm weakened the old bridge.
words.ex_cn: 风暴削弱了那座旧桥。
words.en: To weaken something means to reduce its strength, intensity, or effectiveness.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.tr:
pron. 无论哪个；
adj. 无论哪个的；
words.ex: You can pick whichever book you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选无论哪本书。
words.en: You use whichever to refer to any one of a group of things or people, when it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

chapters.name: Unit 10 Part Two Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He is likely to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能通过考试。
words.en: If you say that something is likely to happen or is likely to be true, you mean that it will probably happen or that it is probably true.

words.ex: He is tired of eating the same food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天吃同样的食物。
words.en: To feel that you have had enough of someone or something and do not want to have to deal with them or it any more.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 放纵自己；尽情宣泄；不再约束自己；不修边幅
words.ex: He started to let himself go after he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后开始放纵自己。
words.en: To allow oneself to behave in a way that is not controlled or restrained, often leading to a decline in personal care or discipline.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；弄懂；明白；领会
words.ex: I can't make sense of this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂这个数学题。
words.en: To understand something that is complicated or unusual.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅰ New Words

words.ex: He felt adrenaline when he jumped from the plane.
words.ex_cn: 当他从飞机上跳下时，感受到了肾上腺素。
words.en: A hormone secreted by the adrenal glands, especially in conditions of stress, increasing rates of blood circulation, breathing, and carbohydrate metabolism and preparing muscles for exertion.

words.ex: Loud noise aggravates his headache.
words.ex_cn: 噪音加重了他的头痛。
words.en: If someone or something aggravates a situation, they make it worse.

words.ex: The aggression of the army caused many deaths.
words.ex_cn: 军队的侵略导致了许多人死亡。
words.en: Aggression is a violent or hostile behavior towards another person or country.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: The cardiac patient needs to rest daily.
words.ex_cn: 这位心脏病人需要每天休息。
words.en: Cardiac means relating to the heart.

words.ex: He saw a cardiologist for his heart pain.
words.ex_cn: 他因为心痛去看了一位心脏病专家。
words.en: A cardiologist is a doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of heart diseases and heart abnormalities.

words.ex: He eats eggs but watches his cholesterol.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋，但注意自己的胆固醇。
words.en: Cholesterol is a substance that exists in the cells of the body and in blood, which can cause heart disease if there is too much of it.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.ex: He had a coronary artery blockage.
words.ex_cn: 他有一条冠状动脉堵塞。
words.en: Relating to the arteries that supply the heart with blood.

words.tr:
n. 律师；劝告
v. 提供咨询；劝告
words.ex: He hired a counsel to defend him in court.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名律师为他在法庭上辩护。
words.en: Counsel refers to the act of giving advice or guidance, especially in a legal context, or to the person who provides such advice.

words.ex: The cumulative score is the total of all previous points.
words.ex_cn: 累积得分是所有之前分数的总和。
words.en: If a series of events have a cumulative effect, each event makes the effect greater.

words.tr: n. 愤世嫉俗者；悲观者；怀疑者
words.ex: He is a cynic who never believes in good intentions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个不相信任何善意的愤世嫉俗者。
words.en: A cynic is someone who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honorable or unselfish reasons.

words.tr: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；悲观的；
words.ex: He gave a cynical smile when they talked about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 当他们谈到诚实时，他露出了愤世嫉俗的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as cynical, you mean they believe that people always act selfishly.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.ex: The accident was fatal.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是致命的。
words.en: If an action or event is fatal, it causes someone's death.

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.ex: The old woman gleaned wheat from the field after the harvest.
words.ex_cn: 这位老妇人在收割后从田里拾落穗。
words.en: To gather information or material bit by bit.

words.tr:
v. 注意；留心
n. 注意；留心
words.ex: He did not heed the warning.
words.ex_cn: 他没有理会那个警告。
words.en: If you heed someone's advice or warning, you pay attention to it and do what they suggest.

words.ex: Hey, can you help me with this?
words.ex_cn: 嗨，你能帮我一下吗？
words.en: used to attract attention or to express surprise, interest, or annoyance

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: There was clear hostility between the two neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间明显存在敌意。
words.en: Hostility is unfriendly or aggressive behaviour towards people or ideas.

words.tr: adj. 不为别人着想的；不体谅别人的；
words.ex: He left the door open and didn't care about others.
words.ex_cn: 他让门敞着，一点也不为别人着想。
words.en: If you describe someone as inconsiderate, you are criticizing them because they do not take enough care over how their words or actions will affect other people.

words.ex: The irritation on his arm hurt when he touched it.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上的疼痛处一碰就疼。
words.en: Irritation is the feeling of annoyance, especially when something keeps happening that you do not like.

words.ex: He mistreats his dog every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天虐待他的狗。
words.en: To treat someone or something in a cruel, harsh, or unfair way.

words.ex: He mistrusts strangers who ask for money.
words.ex_cn: 他不信任向他要钱的陌生人。
words.en: Mistrust is the feeling that you cannot trust someone or something.

words.ex: The mortality rate in the region increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年该地区的死亡率上升了。
words.en: Mortality refers to the state of being subject to death or the number of deaths in a particular population or period.

words.ex: His motive was to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助家人。
words.en: Your motive for doing something is your reason for doing it.

words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.tr: n. 几率；不利条件；不平等；
words.ex: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
words.ex_cn: 中彩票的几率非常低。
words.en: The odds are the chances that a particular thing will happen.

words.ex: There was an outpouring of love after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，人们倾注了满满的爱。
words.en: An outpouring is a very strong expression of feeling or emotion that is expressed openly and often in large amounts.

words.tr: adj. 首创性的；先驱性的； v. “pioneer”的现在分词；
words.ex: He made a pioneering discovery in renewable energy.
words.ex_cn: 他在可再生能源领域做出了开创性的发现。
words.en: Involving new ideas or methods, and being the first to use them in a particular field.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: Handwashing is a simple prevention of disease.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防疾病的一种简单方法。
words.en: The act of stopping something from happening or arising.

words.ex: The quotient of 10 divided by 2 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 10除以2的商是5。
words.en: A quotient is the result you get by dividing one number by another.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.tr: adj. 反复出现的；再发生的；
words.ex: He has recurrent headaches every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都反复出现头痛。
words.en: Happening or appearing again or repeatedly.

words.ex: He refines his writing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天完善自己的写作。
words.en: To refine something means to make it purer or to improve it, especially by removing unwanted substances or by making small changes.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: He looked at her with suspicion.
words.ex_cn: 他带着怀疑的眼神看着她。
words.en: A feeling or thought that something is possible, likely, or true, especially something bad or wrong, without having proof.

words.tr: v. 威胁；“threaten”的现在分词； adj. 威胁的；
words.ex: He was threatening the neighbor with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用棍子威胁邻居。
words.en: If someone's behavior or actions are threatening, they make you feel that they might harm you.

words.ex: He tightened the screw with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 他用扳手把螺丝拧紧。
words.en: If you tighten a rule, policy, or system, you make it stricter or more efficient.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.tr: adj. 看不见的；未被发现的；即席的
words.ex: The unseen danger scared the children.
words.ex_cn: 那看不见的危险吓到了孩子们。
words.en: If something is unseen, it is not seen or noticed by anyone.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅰ Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他马上就要离开家了。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry, you are doing something quickly because you do not have much time.

words.tr: phrase. 在…到…的范围间变动
words.ex: The prices range from $5 to $20.
words.ex_cn: 价格从5美元到20美元不等。
words.en: If things range from one thing to another, they vary within these limits on a scale of measurement or quality.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅱ New Words

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.tr: n. 照顾者；护理者；看护者
words.ex: The caregiver helps the old man every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位照护者每天帮助这位老人。
words.en: A caregiver is someone who is responsible for looking after another person, especially a family member who is sick, elderly, or disabled.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: He felt great distress when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到非常忧虑。
words.en: Distress is a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain.

words.tr: adj. 失意的；挫败的； v. “frustrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt frustrated when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 当他考试不及格时，他感到失意。
words.en: If you are frustrated, you are upset or angry because you are unable to do anything about a situation.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的；引人入胜的； v. “intrigue”的现在分词；
words.ex: The mystery story was intriguing.
words.ex_cn: 这个侦探故事很引人入胜。
words.en: If you describe something as intriguing, you mean that it is interesting or strange.

words.ex: He felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到妒忌。
words.en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: He has a lifelong love for reading.
words.ex_cn: 他对阅读有着终身的热爱。
words.en: Lasting or continuing through all or much of one's life.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.ex: He stood in the midst of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他站在人群中间。
words.en: The middle part or point of something.

words.tr: adv. 自然地；理所当然地；
words.ex: Babies cry naturally when they are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿饿了时会自然地哭。
words.en: in a natural manner; as a matter of course; by nature

words.ex: The nerve in his finger was damaged.
words.ex_cn: 他手指里的神经受到了损伤。
words.en: A nerve is a bundle of fibers that transmits impulses of sensation to the brain or spinal cord, and impulses from these to the muscles and organs. It also refers to the courage or control needed to do something difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: The neuroscientist studies how the brain works.
words.ex_cn: 这位神经科学家研究大脑是如何工作的。
words.en: A neuroscientist is a scientist who specializes in the study of the nervous system, including the brain, spinal cord, and networks of sensory nerve cells called neurons.

words.ex: The child laughed at the puppet on the stage.
words.ex_cn: 孩子笑了，看着舞台上那个木偶。
words.en: A puppet is a doll that you can move by pulling strings which are attached to it or by putting your hand inside its body and moving your fingers.

words.ex: Mom reassured me that everything would be fine.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈让我安心，一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you reassure someone, you comfort them and stop them from worrying.

words.tr:
n. 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；叠句；
v. 克制；
words.ex: His constant refrain is that the food is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨食物太贵。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.tr: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的； v. “scare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was scared of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.tr: n. 学校作业；课堂作业；
words.ex: He finished his schoolwork before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了学校作业。
words.en: Schoolwork refers to the work that students are required to do as part of their studies at school.

words.tr: v. 使安静；安慰；使缓和
words.ex: She sang a song to soothe the baby.
words.ex_cn: 她唱了一首歌来安抚婴儿。
words.en: To soothe someone means to make them feel calmer and less anxious, upset, or angry.

words.tr:
n. 跺脚；顿足爵士舞乐曲
v. 迈着重重的步子走（或跳舞、移动）
words.ex: The baby made a stomp with his foot when he was angry.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝生气时用脚跺了一下。
words.en: To stomp means to walk heavily or noisily, often because you are angry.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.ex: The child threw a tantrum when he couldn't get what he wanted.
words.ex_cn: 孩子因为得不到想要的东西而发脾气。
words.en: A tantrum is an uncontrolled outburst of anger and frustration, typically in a young child.

words.ex: This puzzle is tricky for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜题对孩子来说很棘手。
words.en: If you describe a task or problem as tricky, you mean that it is difficult to deal with and requires careful thinking or skill.

words.tr: adj. 令人不快（或忧虑、苦恼）的； v. “upset”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news was upsetting to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让每个人都感到不快。
words.en: If something is upsetting, it makes you feel unhappy, disappointed, or worried.

words.tr: v. 用言语（或文字）表达
words.ex: He can verbalize his thoughts clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的想法。
words.en: To verbalize means to express something in words, especially to articulate feelings or thoughts clearly.

chapters.name: Unit 10 PASSAGE Ⅱ Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrasal verb. 恢复；重新振作；反弹
words.ex: He bounced back after his injury.
words.ex_cn: 他伤愈后恢复了。
words.en: To return quickly to a normal condition after a difficult situation or event.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之中；在……当中；正当……的时候
words.ex: He is running in the midst of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在人群中奔跑。
words.en: If you are in the midst of doing something, you are doing it at the moment.

words.ex: The pizza is on the way.
words.ex_cn: 披萨正在路上。
words.en: If something or someone is on the way, they are about to arrive or they are in the process of coming or going.
